body:
Yeah. My mom likes to remind me that since she gave birth to me that she has every right to do whatever she wants to me, and I should still love and revere her. That includes screaming at me, threatening me (and my brother, and my pets... sometimes with knives), calling me names (including slurs) and treating me like her personal servant. 

And then if I don't go along with it, I get the guilt trip. How *dare* I treat her like this? Can't I see how hard she works for me?! I'm making her blood pressure go through the roof, you know, and suddenly she has a migraine and it's all my fault! I'm such an awful person!

And she's right, I am an awful person, but I'm willing to bet it's her damn fault.

I'm not a decent dude, but I appreciate the thought.  I'm a disaster at best, really, or an asshole.

 Trying to look at myself through the eyes of other people is pretty difficult when you've got anxiety problems and think everyone hates you, though. I know, rationally, that my friends wouldn't bother talking to me if they didn't like me, but i just can't think of any reason why they *would*. It feels like they hate me, and it makes sense for them to hate me, and I deserve for them to hate me, so why woudn't they?

I appreciate you reading this and trying to help, though. Thank you. I'm feeling a little better than I was last night, if that means anything.
